name: The 9Ф632 trainer: the instructor changes the targets as the crew works
description: A drill in the style of the 9Ф632 trainer (roadmap 10.3): the instructor enters the air picture and changes up to two targets' behaviour while the crew works. Here his drill is scripted: a drone comes straight in and he turns it away across the zone; he brings it back low, under the search radar's clutter height; then a strike aircraft comes in and he switches on its noise pod for the jamming drill. The NPC commander runs the crew; take any seat, or his. In the game the instructor can also be a player (the instructor panel).
notes: The trainer: flak11 and ePap (samsim_thread), docs/research/OSA_RESEARCH_2026-10.md section 7: a Ural-375 with every workplace of the vehicle and an instructor's seat; the instructor enters the air picture and changes up to two targets' behaviour live; ECCM drills. The drill's script, the targets' numbers and the pod (em/generic.json, a placeholder) are SAM3D's. The pod stays off until the instructor switches it on.
